applicant_utility.summary: BUPRS covers a full four-year fee waiver plus a three-year stipend at the current A$34,315 rate, but the scholarship application is only considered once you already hold a doctoral Letter of Offer, and admission alone can take 6-10 weeks. With just a limited number of awards and two hard cut-offs each year (31 March and 30 September), the workable plan is to start the program application months early and have all five assessment documents ready before the window opens.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Full-time PhD or Professional Doctorate of Occupational Therapy candidates, domestic or international, who already hold or can quickly secure a Bond offer and need fees plus living costs covered on the Gold Coast.
application_readiness_checklist: Start the Bond program application early enough to hold a Letter of Offer before round close (Bond warns admission can take 6-10 weeks)
Secure two referees willing to upload reports directly into the scholarship application form
Obtain academic transcripts that show results, grading scales and evidence of completion
Build a CV that lists publications and conference presentations
Finalise a research project proposal aligned to a potential supervisor
common_rejection_risks: Submitting after the round closure date - late applications are not accepted, full stop
An incomplete form: scholarship applications cannot be accepted unless all required documents are uploaded
Applying while holding an equivalent Commonwealth award designed to offset HDR fees
A repeat application that does not outline genuinely changed circumstances; a second failure permanently ends eligibility
Applying as a research master's student, who is not eligible for any HDR scholarship
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Relocation to the Gold Coast and flights, day-to-day living costs above the stipend, and any additional program costs; Bond states the stipend supports day-to-day expenses and does not include tuition fees.
applicant_utility.document_audit: Transcripts must carry the awarding institution's grading scale and proof of completion or the package is incomplete. The two referee reports must be uploaded into the form itself rather than sent separately by email. Withdrawing formally before the round closing date is the only clean reset if you need to resubmit.
alerts: The round running 1 August - 30 September 2026 closed before this verification date; target the 1 February - 31 March 2027 window
You get at most two scholarship attempts in total: a second unsuccessful application ends future eligibility
Part-time study is not the standard route - a 0.5 FTE scholarship is only considered for significant caring commitments or a medical condition or disability, never for employment
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Bond Admissions processes the program application and issues the Letter of Offer, then you lodge the online Higher Degree Scholarship Application form with all five documents attached before the round closes.

applicant_utility.summary: ACU's Stipend Scholarship bundles a A$34,315 annual stipend with a full fee offset worth roughly A$34,728, plus health cover and up to A$2,000 relocation for international applicants, but it only opens twice a year with hard 1 April and 1 October cut-offs. Future students ride on the research degree application while current enrolled students use a separate Student Portal form emailed to the Graduate Research School, so confirm which lane you are in before documents are due.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Research doctorate and research master's candidates, domestic or international, whose project fits ACU's broad areas of expertise and who need tuition plus living costs covered for the full candidature.
application_readiness_checklist: Check that your proposed topic aligns with ACU's broad areas of expertise and identified research strengths before you write
Draft the 2,000-word proposal as a text-searchable PDF or Word file, not a scan
Get transcripts and identity documents certified by a JP, notary, AskACU centre or Australian embassy
Line up referees early - their reports can arrive up to one week after the application deadline, but only if nominated on time
Arrange English test evidence within two years of your start date if your prior study was not in English
Current students: pull the scholarship form from the Student Portal and email it with attachments to grad.research@acu.edu.au
common_rejection_risks: Late or incomplete lodgement - ACU reserves the right not to consider either
A proposal that does not connect to any ACU research strength or available supervision
Uncertified transcripts or identity documents, which the FAQ flags as a certification requirement
Missing the twice-yearly window entirely, since there is no rolling intake for this scholarship
Holding an equivalent Commonwealth award designed to offset research higher degree fees
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Relocation and flights above the $2,000 international allowance, dependants' relocation costs (extra allowance only at the Director's discretion), and general living costs beyond the indexed stipend.
applicant_utility.document_audit: Transcripts, birth certificates, citizenship certificates and passports all require certified copies, and anything not in English needs a translation attached. The proposal must be a text-searchable PDF or .docx - an image-only scan will stall assessment. Current students additionally need an enrolment summary.
